_note: Ranges measured 29 Oct 2026 with voice_style.py. isaac = his 7 videos from 2024-2026 (I01-I04, I07-I09; his 2023 videos I05/I06 were flatter). zack = Zack D. Films' pace with Isaac-level life. format-long = Zack's long videos. Each entry: [low, high, what to do if it fails].

speed_wps: Too slow: tighten joins and speed up 3-6 % with pitch kept. Too fast: add || holds on key points.
phrase_speed_variation_pct: Too even: comp phrases from different takes, add a slow [pause]d line before reveals and a fast aside.
tone_swing_semitones: Monotone: add tone tags where the mood changes, "!" and "...", then re-comp from the liveliest takes.
stressed_words_per_min: Flat stress: one CAPS word in more sentences. Too much: remove CAPS from minor words.
long_pauses_per_min: Add || holds after reveals, punchlines and key points (or remove some if it drags).
mid_pauses_per_min: Use commas and "..." inside sentences for small breaths.
fillers_per_min: Write in a few conversational words (look, I mean, okay so, wait) where a person would say them.
loudness_swing_db: Too even: add a whispered or softly line and an excited line; avoid heavy compression before the check.

speed_wps: Zack pace is about 2.8-3.0 words a second: cut words, or slow the read with [slowly] on one line.
phrase_speed_variation_pct: Comp phrases from different takes for natural variation.
tone_swing_semitones: Monotone: re-comp from the liveliest takes; one tone tag at the start; CAPS on the key word.
stressed_words_per_min: Too few: one CAPS stress word per batch. Too many: remove CAPS and "!" from minor words.
long_pauses_per_min: Zack never pauses: remove || holds and "..."; tighten joins to 0.1 s.
mid_pauses_per_min: Remove commas that create breaks; tighten joins.
fillers_per_min: Zack uses no fillers: remove them (note: common words like "so" and "like" also count here).

speed_wps: Zack long-video pace is about 2.8 words a second.
phrase_speed_variation_pct: Comp phrases from different takes; slow down before reveals.
tone_swing_semitones: Monotone: re-comp from the liveliest takes; tags where the mood changes.
stressed_words_per_min: Too few: one CAPS stress word in more sentences. Too many: remove CAPS from minor words.
long_pauses_per_min: Holds only where the edit has a music drop or black beat.
mid_pauses_per_min: Use commas and "..." inside sentences for small breaths.
fillers_per_min: Zack uses almost no fillers: remove them.
loudness_swing_db: Add a softer line in tense moments.
